= Little Commanders =

''A game of toy armies on hexagon tiles for 2 to 6 players. Working title.''

== Rules (game option) ==
* '''Basic''': production, Mechs, combat and Missions. Moving costs 1 Credit per step. No Docks, Ports or market.
* '''Advanced''': Basic plus Docks, Ports and the market with moving prices.

== Goal ==
Be the first commander to reach '''5 Victory Points'''. Victory Points come only from '''Mission cards'''.

== Your turn ==
At the start of your turn you gain '''10 Credits''' and your buildings can work again. Then, in any order, you may build, make pieces, move, buy a Mission and (Advanced) trade. Your attacks are decided when you end your turn.

== Tiles and control ==
You '''control''' a tile while one of your pieces stands on it. Everything printed on the tile (resource, building sockets, roads) belongs to the tile. Roads only connect where both touching tiles show a road; a tiny broken stump means no road. The letters and numbers around the board name every tile; the log uses the same names.

== Buildings ==
* '''Extractor''' (1 iron): once per turn, pay 1 Credit to take 1 token of the tile's resource.
* '''Factory''' (2 iron): once per turn, pay 1 Credit: 1 iron becomes 2 Bots, or 1 iron and 1 crystal become 1 Mech.
* '''Guard Tower''' (2 iron): makes the tile harder to push and kill.

== Moving ==
Every step costs 1 Credit per piece. Pieces follow open roads and cannot pass through enemy pieces. Resources (iron and crystal) cannot move on their own: you must have a Bot at the starting hex and destination hex (or send a Bot escorting them).

== Missions ==
Pay 5 Credits (plus 1 for each Mission you already bought) to buy a face-up Mission, one per turn. You score only if you meet its condition at that moment; otherwise the Credits are lost.

== Combat ==
A Bot has power 1, a Mech power 5. To push a defender you need twice its power, to kill it three times; each Guard Tower adds 1 to both multipliers. If the attack is too weak it fails and the attackers return.

== Market (Advanced) ==
Trade at your home Dock (iron and bots) or at a Port you control. Each post trades once per turn for 1 Credit: pick one good and buy or sell any number at the current price; afterwards the price moves one step per item traded.
